suite: the Groups switches (the map's containers on both models, the grid's assemblies on the fixture)
expect_red: the fixture's map: each switch off hides its own containers, a bearing's outline across two districts among them, and leaves every pin where it was

mutations.contract: Assemblies off hides an assembly with no box of its own -- its outline, the one drawing it has -- as well as one round a box.
mutations.note: Only the outlines round a box are hidden: v2's three go and the fixture's four box-less outlines, the bearings across two districts among them, stay drawn.
